title: Forbidden Trail
description: A practical-joking cowboy (Buck Jones) gets serious with outlaws.

title: The Professionals
description: A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.

title: The California Trail
description: Cowboy Santa Fe Stewart (Buck Jones) fights a tyrant in Spanish California.

title: Count Three and Pray
description: A preacher (Van Heflin) with a reckless past rebuilds a church after the Civil War with a teenage girl (Joanne Woodward) from the hills.

title: Jack McCall, Desperado
description: During the Civil War, a Southerner joins the Union Army and is accused of leaking information to the Confederates.

title: A Lawless Street
description: The wife (Angela Lansbury) of a roving marshal (Randolph Scott) wants him to quit, but first he has to clean up Medicine Bend.

title: Comanche Station
description: Three outlaws join a loner (Randolph Scott) and another man's wife (Nancy Gates), who was kidnapped by Indians.

title: Decision at Sundown
description: A gunman (Randolph Scott) rides into Sundown for a showdown with the big shot (John Carroll) he blames for stealing his wife.

title: 3:10 to Yuma
description: A rancher (Van Heflin) needing cash is hired to put an outlaw (Glenn Ford) on the train to Yuma prison.

title: The Big Gundown
description: Lawman John Corbett (Lee Van Cleef) searches the U.S.-Mexico border for a Mexican peasant (Tomas Milian) accused of raping and killing a 12-year-old girl.

title: Headin' East
description: A cowboy discards his chaps and saddle for a suit and tie when he travels to the big city to investigate a produce racket that has been ruining his father's lettuce shipments.

title: The Law vs. Billy the Kid
description: Outlaw Billy (Scott Brady) courts a rancher's daughter (Betta St. John) and is hunted by lawman Pat Garrett (James Griffith).

title: The Last Posse
description: A posse led by an alcoholic sheriff pursues the Drune family after they rob a wealthy rancher. Several days later, the Drunes are all dead, the sheriff is wounded, and the money has disappeared.

title: The Stranger Wore a Gun
description: A man whose life was saved by an outlaw shows his gratitude by reluctantly assisting in a stagecoach robbery.

title: Wyoming Renegades
description: An ex-convict (Phil Carey) and his girlfriend (Martha Hyer) cannot start over until they stop Butch Cassidy's (Gene Evans) gang.

title: The Texican
description: A fugitive lawman (Audie Murphy) leaves Mexico to get the Texas saloon boss (Broderick Crawford) who framed him and killed his brother.

title: Stage to Tucson
description: Troubleshooters track Arizona stagecoaches hijacked for sale to the Confederacy.

title: Unknown Valley
description: Joe goes looking for his missing father in the desert, then strange villagers take him captive; he finds his father and plans to escape, taking with him a woman that he has fallen for.

title: Go West, Young Girl!
description: New England writer Netty and cavalry widow Gilda team up to find Billy the Kid.

title: Reprisal!
description: An Indian girl (Kathryn Grant) and a land agent's daughter (Felicia Farr) save a part-Indian cattle rancher (Guy Madison) from vigilantes.

title: They Rode West
description: The new doctor (Robert Francis) at a cavalry fort finds resentment at first, even more once he treats Indians.

title: Dirty Little Billy
description: Farm boy Billy Bonney (Michael J. Pollard) rebels in 1870s Kansas and goes on to become Billy the Kid.

title: The Last Rebel
description: Two Confederates (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) save a man's (Woody Strode) life and cause trouble in 1865 Missouri.

title: The Thrill Hunter
description: After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.

title: Gunmen From Laredo
description: A framed Texas rancher escapes from prison for a showdown with a saloon keeper.

title: Al Jennings of Oklahoma
description: Lawyer Al (Dan Duryea) and brother Frank (Dick Foran) turn to robbing banks and trains after Union troops raid their home.

title: Legend of the Golden Gun
description: An Old West gunfighter (Hal Holbrook) turns a young farmer (Jeff Osterhage) into a justice fighter with a special gun.

title: The New Daughters of Joshua Cabe
description: A framed sheriff (John McIntire) is about to hang, but his bogus wayward daughters have a plan.

title: The Pathfinder
description: A British scout (Kevin Dillon) infiltrates a French stronghold near the Great Lakes during the 1750s.

title: Face of a Fugitive
